tools.name: compress_pdf
tools.description: Compress a PDF to reduce its file size while keeping it readable.

tools.name: merge_pdfs
tools.description: Merge several PDF files into a single document, in the given order.

tools.name: split_pdf
tools.description: Split a PDF into several smaller PDFs.

tools.name: extract_pages
tools.description: Extract specific pages from a PDF into a new PDF (pages are 1-indexed).

tools.name: rotate_pdf
tools.description: Rotate all pages, or selected pages, of a PDF.
